items.question: How long is the UAE mandatory national service term for male recruits who hold a high school diploma, under Resolution No. 15 of 2022?
items.fact: Male high school graduates' national service term is 11 months

items.question: What is the total area of Wahat Al Karama, the memorial opposite the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in Abu Dhabi, in square metres?
items.fact: Wahat Al Karama spans 46,000 square metres in Abu Dhabi
